name: esp32-sys-health
description: Header-only ESP32 heap / stack / reset-cause health monitor for Arduino-ESP32. Samples free and minimum heap, largest block, fragmentation, PSRAM, per-task stack headroom and uptime; classifies ok/warn/fault against configurable floors; records the fault reason in RTC memory so the next boot can report it; decodes esp_reset_reason; optional core-dump summary and TWAI/CAN counters. Also ota_pull.h: header-only pull-model OTA (manifest fetch with optional HMAC, SHA-256-verified streaming download into the inactive slot, bootloader rollback bookkeeping) with policy left to the caller.
keywords: esp32, heap, stack, fragmentation, watchdog, reset reason, diagnostics, health, freertos, ota, rollback, update
